title: wCDM / w0waCDM (CPL parametrization, Chevallier–Polarski–Linder)
efc_relevance: Phenomenological w(a) = w0 + wa(1−a). EFC's L2→L3 regime transition gives an effective w(z) that maps onto the (w0, wa) plane; DESI DR2's 3.1σ preference for w0wa is directionally consistent with EFC's α = −0.14 ± 0.21. Shared signal, not EFC-exclusive.
ledger_action: Logged as parametric-competitor for background-sector tests. Cross-reference arXiv:2503.14738 (DESI DR2) and ledger_darkenergy_evolution_wz.
